```{r all long-term sites with no less than 10-year data}
library(librarian)
shelf(tidyverse, terra)
#
# I need to check this again. 
# site: CA-Cbo, US-Ho1, US-Me2, US-Ton, US-UMB, AmeriFlux FLUXNET data has problems. use partitioned data by ReddyProc. 
# CA-Cbo in FLUXNET_shuttle results look good, not like previous AmeriFlux_FLUXNET data.  
# CA-Ca3 ?

source(file.path("scripts2026", "00_functions.R"))

# sites in FLUXNET2015 only
files_FLUXNET2015 <- list.files(path =  file.path(dir_rawdata, "FLUXNET2015", "unzip_select"), pattern = "_FLUXNET2015_FULLSET_(HH|HR)_")
sites_FLUXNET2015 <- unlist(lapply(files_FLUXNET2015, function(x) substring(x, 5, 10)))

# sites in FLUXNET2015 and shuttle
files_FLUXNET2015_shuttle <- list.files(path =  file.path(dir_rawdata, "Fluxnet_shuttle", "unzip_connect2015"), pattern = "_FLUXNET_FLUXMET_(HH|HR)_")
sites_FLUXNET2015_shuttle <- unlist(lapply(files_FLUXNET2015_shuttle, function(x) substring(x, 6, 11)))

# sites in FLUXNET2025 and shuttle
files_FLUXNET2025_shuttle <- list.files(path =  file.path(dir_rawdata, "Fluxnet_shuttle", "unzip_connect2025"), pattern = "_FLUXNET_FLUXMET_(HH|HR)_")
sites_FLUXNET2025_shuttle <- unlist(lapply(files_FLUXNET2025_shuttle, function(x) substring(x, 6, 11)))

# sites in fluxnet shuttle only 
files_fluxnet_shuttle <- list.files(path =  file.path(dir_rawdata, "Fluxnet_shuttle", "unzip_select"), pattern="_FLUXNET_FLUXMET_(HH|HR)_")
sites_fluxnet_shuttle <- unlist(lapply(files_fluxnet_shuttle, function(x) substring(x, 5, 10)))
# BR-Sa1, use partitioned data by us
sites_fluxnet_shuttle <- sites_fluxnet_shuttle[!sites_fluxnet_shuttle %in% c("BR-Sa1", "US-Cwt")]

# one AmeriFlux FLUXNET site was missed from fluxnet shuttle
files_Ameri_FLUXNET <- list.files(path =  file.path(dir_rawdata, "Ameriflux_FLUXNET", "unzip"), pattern = "_FLUXNET_FULLSET_HH_")
sites_Ameri_FLUXNET <- unlist(lapply(files_Ameri_FLUXNET, function(x) substring(x, 5, 10)))

# sites in Ameriflux BASE
files_Ameri_BASE <- list.files(path =  file.path(dir_rawdata, "Ameriflux_BASE", "ReddyProcGapFill"), pattern = "\\_HH.csv$")
sites_Ameri_BASE <- unlist(lapply(files_Ameri_BASE, function(x) substring(x, 5, 10)))
sites_Ameri_BASE <- setdiff(sites_Ameri_BASE, c(sites_FLUXNET2015, sites_FLUXNET2015_shuttle, sites_FLUXNET2025_shuttle, sites_fluxnet_shuttle))
# remove sites with < 10 years of data
sites_Ameri_BASE <- sites_Ameri_BASE[!sites_Ameri_BASE %in% c('US-LL2', 'US-LL3', 'US-Snd')]

# # sites in HRBFlux2022, it turns out we do not need these sites, as they are in Fluxnet shuttle
# files_HRBFlux2022 <- list.files(path = file.path(dir_rawdata, "HRBFlux2022", "csv"), pattern = "ReddyProcRF_FULLSET_HH")
# sites_HRBFlux2022 <- unlist(lapply(files_HRBFlux2022, function(x) substring(x, 9, 14)))
# # remove duplicated sites 
# sites_HRBFlux2022 <- sites_HRBFlux2022[!tolower(sites_HRBFlux2022) %in% tolower(sites_fluxnet_shuttle)]
#
# characteristics of these sites: climate, vegetation, MAP, MAT, Elevation
sites_long <- data.frame(site_ID = c(sites_FLUXNET2015, sites_FLUXNET2015_shuttle, 
                                     sites_FLUXNET2025_shuttle, sites_fluxnet_shuttle, 
                                     sites_Ameri_FLUXNET, sites_Ameri_BASE), 
                          source = c(rep("FLUXNET2015", length(sites_FLUXNET2015)), 
                                     rep("FLUXNET2015_shuttle", length(sites_FLUXNET2015_shuttle)), 
                                     rep("FLUXNET2025_shuttle", length(sites_FLUXNET2025_shuttle)), 
                                     rep("FLUXNET_shuttle", length(sites_fluxnet_shuttle)),
                                     rep("AmeriFlux_FLUXNET", length(sites_Ameri_FLUXNET)), 
                                     rep("AmeriFlux_BASE", length(sites_Ameri_BASE))
                                     ) )
#
# get climate and vegetation information for these sites
sites_info_Ameri <- read.csv(file.path('data2026', 'AmeriFlux-site-search-results-202512092232.csv'))
# rename some of these columns
sites_info_Ameri <- sites_info_Ameri %>% rename("Lat"="Latitude..degrees.", 
                                                "Long"="Longitude..degrees.",
                                                "IGBP"="Vegetation.Abbreviation..IGBP.", 
                                                "Climate.class"="Climate.Class.Abbreviation..Koeppen.",
                                                "MAT"="Mean.Average.Temperature..degrees.C.",  
                                                "MAP"="Mean.Average.Precipitation..mm.")
#
sites_info_Europ <- read.csv(file.path("data2026", "European_SitesList.csv"))
#
sites_info_Europ <- sites_info_Europ %>% rename("Site.ID"="Site.Code", "Lat"="Site.Latitude",
                                                "Long"="Site.Longitude", "IGBP"="IGBP.Code", 
                                                "MAT" = "Mean.Annual.Temperature", 
                                                "MAP" = "Mean.Annual.Precpitation") %>%
  mutate(MAT = as.numeric(MAT)) %>% filter(!Site.ID %in% c(sites_info_Ameri$Site.ID))
#
sites_info_China <- read.csv(file.path("data2026", "metadata_ChinaFlux.csv"))
sites_info_China <- sites_info_China %>% filter(!Site.ID %in% c(sites_info_Ameri$Site.ID, sites_info_Europ$Site.ID))
#
sites_info_Japan <- read.csv(file.path("data2026", "metadata_JapanFlux2024.csv"))
sites_info_Japan <- sites_info_Japan %>% rename("Site.ID"="Site.code..BADM.",
                                                "Lat"="Latitude..degree.",
                                                "Long"="Longitude..degree.",
                                                "IGBP"="IGBP..land.use.", 
                                                "Climate.class" = "Köppen.climate", 
                                                "MAT"="MAT..TA...C.",
                                                "MAP"="MAP..PREC..mm.yr...") %>%
  filter(!Site.ID %in% c(sites_info_Ameri$Site.ID, sites_info_Europ$Site.ID))
#  
sites_info_Oz <- read.csv(file.path("data2026", "metadata_OzFlux.csv"))
sites_info_Oz <- sites_info_Oz %>% filter(!is.na(site_ID)) %>% rename("Site.ID"="site_ID",
                                                                      "Climate.class" = "Köppen_climate") %>%
  filter(!Site.ID %in% c(sites_info_Ameri$Site.ID, sites_info_Europ$Site.ID))
#
sites_info_fluxnet_shuttle <- read.csv(file.path("data2026", "fluxnet_shuttle_snapshot_20260717T143751_selectedsites.csv"))
# 
sites_info_fluxnet_shuttle <- sites_info_fluxnet_shuttle %>% rename("Site.ID"="site_id", "Lat"="location_lat",
                                                "Long"="location_long", "IGBP"="igbp") %>%
  filter(!Site.ID %in% c(sites_info_Ameri$Site.ID, sites_info_Europ$Site.ID, sites_info_China$Site.ID, 
                         sites_info_Japan$Site.ID, sites_info_Oz$Site.ID))
#

# put all sites together
sites_all <- bind_rows(sites_info_Ameri[, c("Site.ID", "Lat", "Long", "IGBP", "Climate.class", "MAT", "MAP")], 
                       sites_info_Europ[, c("Site.ID", "Lat", "Long", "IGBP", "MAT", "MAP")],
                       sites_info_China[, c("Site.ID", "Lat", "Long", "IGBP", "MAT", "MAP")],
                       sites_info_Japan[, c("Site.ID", "Lat", "Long", "IGBP", "Climate.class", "MAT", "MAP")],
                       sites_info_Oz[, c("Site.ID", "Lat", "Long", "IGBP", "Climate.class", "MAP")],
                       sites_info_fluxnet_shuttle[, c("Site.ID", "Lat", "Long", "IGBP")])

# get climate classes for these locations
climate_koppen   <- terra::rast(file.path('data2026', 'koppen_geiger_0p00833333.tif'))
# plot(climate_koppen)
#
# get climate for all flux sites based on coordinates
xy <- data.frame(x=sites_all$Long, y=sites_all$Lat)
#
tmp <- terra::extract(climate_koppen, xy)
#
tmp <- tmp %>% mutate(koppen = case_when(
  #
  # We do not have so many climates in the first category
  koppen_geiger_0p00833333 == 21 ~ 'Dwa', 
  koppen_geiger_0p00833333 == 22 ~ 'Dwb', 
  koppen_geiger_0p00833333 == 23 ~ 'Dwc', 
  koppen_geiger_0p00833333 == 24 ~ 'Dwd',
  #
  koppen_geiger_0p00833333 == 25 ~ 'Dfa',  
  koppen_geiger_0p00833333 == 26 ~ 'Dfb', 
  koppen_geiger_0p00833333 == 27 ~ 'Dfc', 
  koppen_geiger_0p00833333 == 28 ~ 'Dfd', 
  koppen_geiger_0p00833333 == 29 ~ 'ET',
  koppen_geiger_0p00833333 == 30 ~ 'ET',
  #
  koppen_geiger_0p00833333 == 10 ~ 'Csc',   
  koppen_geiger_0p00833333 == 9  ~ 'Csb', 
  koppen_geiger_0p00833333 == 8  ~ 'Csa',
  koppen_geiger_0p00833333 == 7  ~ 'BSk',
  koppen_geiger_0p00833333 == 6  ~ 'BSh',
  koppen_geiger_0p00833333 == 5  ~ 'BWk',  
  koppen_geiger_0p00833333 == 4  ~ 'BWh',
  #
  koppen_geiger_0p00833333 == 3  ~ 'Aw',
  koppen_geiger_0p00833333 == 2  ~ 'Am',
  koppen_geiger_0p00833333 == 1  ~ 'Af',
  #
  koppen_geiger_0p00833333 == 17  ~ 'Dsa',  
  koppen_geiger_0p00833333 == 18  ~ 'Dsb',  
  koppen_geiger_0p00833333 == 19  ~ 'Dsc',
  koppen_geiger_0p00833333 == 20  ~ 'Dsd',
  #
  koppen_geiger_0p00833333 == 14  ~ 'Cfa',
  koppen_geiger_0p00833333 == 15  ~ 'Cfb',
  koppen_geiger_0p00833333 == 16  ~ 'Cfc',  
  #
  koppen_geiger_0p00833333 == 11  ~ 'Cwa',
  koppen_geiger_0p00833333 == 12  ~ 'Cwb',
  koppen_geiger_0p00833333 == 13  ~ 'Cwc',
  #
))
#
sites_all$Climate.class[is.na(sites_all$Climate.class) | sites_all$Climate.class == ''] <- tmp$koppen[is.na(sites_all$Climate.class) | sites_all$Climate.class == '']
#
#####correct some climate classification
sites_all$Climate.class[sites_all$Site.ID=='CA-LP1'] <- 'Dfb'
# sites_all$Climate.class[sites_all$Site.ID=='US-MtB'] <- 'Csb'   # use the reported climate
sites_all$Climate.class[sites_all$Site.ID=='US-MBP'] <- 'Dfb'
sites_all$Climate.class[sites_all$Site.ID=='IT-Tor'] <- 'Dfc'
# adjust based on JapanFlux meta data
sites_all$Climate.class[sites_all$Site.ID=='JP-Fhk'] <- 'Cfa'

#
# remove duplicated sites
sites_all <- sites_all %>% distinct()
#
sites_long <- sites_long %>% left_join(sites_all, by=c("site_ID" = "Site.ID")) %>% filter(!IGBP %in% c('CRO', 'SNO'))
# 
# giving missing climate classes to US-Elm, US-Esm: Cwa
sites_long$Climate.class[sites_long$site_ID %in% c("US-Elm", "US-Esm")] <- "Cwa"
sites_long$Climate.class[sites_long$site_ID %in% c("US-Akn")] <- "Cfa"

## remove some long-term sites that are managed, disturbance affected, or data with known problems:
## CA-TP1: Ontario - Turkey Point 2002 Plantation White Pine; 
## CA-Ca2: British Columbia - Clearcut Douglas-fir stand (harvested winter 1999/2000)
## US-Rpf: Poker Flat Research Range: Succession from fire scar to deciduous forest; 
## US-Me6: this is a burned sites. 
## US-Myb: a restoration site
## CA-Ca2: clearcut around 2000
## US-KLS: actually a crop site, not a grassland site. 
## US-NC1: In 2004, 70 ha of 75 year old native hardwoods was harvested. Following the clearcut,the stand was bedded and planted with loblolly pine seedlings.
## US-NC3: The North Carolina Clearcut site #3.  
## US-Tw4: The Twitchell East End Wetland is a newly constructed restored wetland on Twitchell Island, CA. 
## US-SP2: Even aged slash pine (Pinus elliottii) plantation. Planted in Jan. 1999. data 1999-2009.
## CL-SDP: Bad quality data, especially in 2020.
## DE-Hzd: a strong storm cleared this site. 
## US-Blo: 10-year data but large gaps in some years. 
## US-NR3 and US-NR4: long time series but large gaps. Alpine tundra sites. 
## IT-Lav and IT-TrF: nighttime NEEs have problems at the two sites. 
## the US-Akn measurements actually started from 2016; removed
## ZM-Mon: too few years of good data
## US-UMd: disturbance site
## IT-SRo: change in instrumentation; https://doi.org/10.5194/bg-21-1827-2024
## DE-HoH: sites with large GPP and ER trends, problematic indicated by: A robust data cleaning procedure for eddy covariance flux measurements
## disturbed sites in Japan flux excluded
## ID-PaB: Palangkaraya Drained Burnt forest
## "JP-NsC": chemical fertilizer application sites; i kept the two sites
## "JP-NsM": Mature application sites
## DE-RuC: clearcut sites
## US-Vcm: fire burned every tree in 2013, so this site should be removed.
## JP-Khw: monitoring disrupted in 2004:2006; jumped flux during the interrupted period. 
## CN-ARS: is the same with CN-Aro, so we remove this one. 
## CN-SDQ: is the same with CN-Sdq, so we remove this one. 
## RU-Sam: i think this site should be removed because the tower height increased between July 2007 and June 2009 (https://essd.copernicus.org/articles/11/221/2019/)
## ID-PaD: measurement height changed multiple times in 2011, 2012, 2013, 2016 (https://www.sciencedirect.com/science/article/abs/pii/S0022169421009562)
## AT-Neu: this site is a managed agricultural and grassland. NEE is highly positive, distinct from other sites. 
               ## JP-Tmd: a disturbed site after hurricane
## BJ-Nhu: mixed cropland site
## US-Ho3: Harvested site and irregular measurements


## please note that fertilization sites were not excluded. 
sites_long <- sites_long %>% filter(!site_ID %in% c('CA-TP1', 'US-Rpf', 'US-Me6', 'US-Myb', "CA-Ca2", "US-KLS", "US-NC1", "US-NC3", "US-Tw4", "US-SP2", "CL-SDP", "DE-Hzd", "US-Blo", "US-NR3", "US-NR4", "IT-Lav", "IT-TrF", "US-Akn", "ZM-Mon", "US-UMd", "IT-SRo", "DE-HoH", "DE-RuC", "ID-PaB", "US-Vcm", "JP-Khw", "CN-ARS", "CN-SDQ", "RU-Sam", "ID-PaD", "AT-Neu",
                                                  "BJ-Nhu", "US-Ho3"))
#
# Add NEE partition method
sites_long <- sites_long %>% mutate(NEEpartition = case_when( 
site_ID %in% c("BR-Sa1", "US-NC2", "US-SP3", "US-WCr", "US-Ho2", "US-NC4", "US-Kon", "US-MOz", "CH-Lae", "US-Oho", 
               "DE-RuW", "US-Uaf", "US-Esm", "US-Elm", "US-MtB", "US-Prr", "CA-Cbo", "US-PFa", "CN-ARS", "CN-HZZ", 
               "US-Los", "US-Ho1", "US-UMB", "US-Ton", "CH-Aws", "JP-Tak", "JP-Yms", "US-Aud", "US-ICt", "US-ICs", 
               "US-Jo2", "AU-Ync", "CN-ZYW", "CN-SDQ", "CN-DSL", "AU-TTE") ~ 'NT',
TRUE ~ 'DT'))

# make climate class consistent
sites_long$Climate.class[sites_long$Climate.class == "Bwh"] <- "BWh"
sites_long$Climate.class[sites_long$Climate.class == "Bwk"] <- "BWk"
sites_long$Climate.class[sites_long$Climate.class == "Bsh"] <- "BSh"
sites_long$Climate.class[sites_long$Climate.class == "Bsk"] <- "BSk"

# after disturbance this site transition to DBF after 2014; https://essd.copernicus.org/articles/17/3807/2025/essd-17-3807-2025-discussion.html
sites_long$IGBP[sites_long$site_ID == "JP-Tmd"] <- "DBF"

```


```{r gap-fill some yearly NEE GPP ER data with only missing short-term data in non-growing season }
## this script takes a few minutes

## site, year, gap month, total gap period
source(file.path("scripts2026", "00_functions.R"))
df_file_structure <- get_rawflux_file_structure(dir_rawdata)

a_YY_Cflux <- data.frame(site_ID = character(), TIMESTAMP = integer(), NEE_VUT_REF = double(), 
                         GPP_DT_VUT_REF = double(), RECO_DT_VUT_REF = double(), 
                         GPP_NT_VUT_REF = double(), RECO_NT_VUT_REF = double())

perform_rf <- data.frame()
gap_site_year <- data.frame()
for (i in 1:nrow(sites_long)) {
# for (i in 1:40) {
  
  print(i)
  site <- sites_long$site_ID[i]
  print(site)
  folder <- unlist(df_file_structure$folders[df_file_structure$sources == sites_long$source[i]])
  DDfile <- df_file_structure$DDfiles[df_file_structure$sources == sites_long$source[i]]
  YYfile <- df_file_structure$YYfiles[df_file_structure$sources == sites_long$source[i]]
  a_DD <- read.csv(folder[grepl(pattern=paste0(site, DDfile), folder)])
  a_YY <- read.csv(folder[grepl(pattern=paste0(site, YYfile), folder)])
  #
  a_DD[a_DD<=-9999] <- NA
  a_YY[a_YY<=-9999] <- NA
  #
  # deal with fluxnet shuttle data only; do not gap fill the CH-Lae site
  if (sites_long$source[i] != "FLUXNET_shuttle" || site == "CH-Lae") {
    a_YY_Cflux <- bind_rows(a_YY_Cflux, a_YY %>% select(any_of(c("TIMESTAMP", "NEE_VUT_REF", "GPP_DT_VUT_REF", "RECO_DT_VUT_REF", "GPP_NT_VUT_REF", "RECO_NT_VUT_REF"))) %>% mutate(site_ID = site, filled = FALSE, .before = 1) )
    next
  } 
  
  #
  a_DD$TIMESTAMP <- ymd(a_DD$TIMESTAMP)
  a_DD <- a_DD %>% mutate(year=year(a_DD$TIMESTAMP), doy=yday(a_DD$TIMESTAMP), month = month(a_DD$TIMESTAMP))
  
  gpp_cols <- intersect(c("GPP_DT_VUT_REF", "GPP_NT_VUT_REF"), names(a_DD))
  a_DD$GPP <- dplyr::coalesce(!!!a_DD[gpp_cols])
  grow_month = a_DD %>% 
    group_by(month) %>% summarise(GPP_mean = mean(GPP, na.rm = T), .groups = "drop") %>% arrange(desc(GPP_mean)) %>% 
    head(6) %>% pull(month) 
  
  gap_by_year <- a_DD %>%
    group_by(year) %>%
    summarise(
      n_days = n(),
      n_gap_days = sum(is.na(NEE_VUT_REF)),
      max_gap_days = max_gap_length(NEE_VUT_REF),
      n_gap_days_gs = sum(is.na(NEE_VUT_REF) & month %in% grow_month),
      gap_fraction = n_gap_days / n_days,
      .groups = "drop"
    ) 
  gap_by_year <- gap_by_year %>% left_join(a_YY[, c("TIMESTAMP", "NEE_VUT_REF")], by = c("year" = "TIMESTAMP"))
  
  # print(gap_by_year)
  if (sum(gap_by_year$n_gap_days > 1) > 0) {
    gap_site_year <- bind_rows(gap_site_year, data.frame(site_ID = site, gap_by_year[gap_by_year$n_gap_days >= 1, ]))
    
    # we only fill gaps with length <= 3 months and no growing season gaps
    years2fill <- gap_by_year$year[between(gap_by_year$n_gap_days, 1, 91) & gap_by_year$n_gap_days_gs == 0 | between(gap_by_year$n_gap_days, 1, 31)] 
    if (length(years2fill) > 0) {
      # doy of gaps to be filled; use observations extended 2 weeks before and after gaps. 
      doy2fill <- a_DD$doy[ (a_DD$year %in% years2fill) & is.na(a_DD$NEE_VUT_REF) ]
      doy2train <- extend_gap_doy(doy2fill, n_extend = 14)
      
      # gap fill GPP and RECO
      a_DD <- a_DD %>% mutate(doy_sin = sin(2 * pi * doy / 365), doy_cos = cos(2 * pi * doy / 365))
      nee_predictors  <- c("SW_IN_F", "TA_F", "VPD_F", "doy_sin", "doy_cos")
      gpp_predictors  <- c("SW_IN_F", "TA_F", "VPD_F", "doy_sin", "doy_cos")
      reco_predictors <- c("TA_F", "VPD_F", "doy_sin", "doy_cos")
      
      gapfill_specs <- tibble::tribble(
        ~response,          ~filled_output,    ~imputed_output,    ~predictors,
        "NEE_VUT_REF",      "NEE_filled",      "NEE_imputed",      list(nee_predictors),
        "GPP_DT_VUT_REF",   "GPP_DT_filled",   "GPP_DT_imputed",   list(gpp_predictors),
        "GPP_NT_VUT_REF",   "GPP_NT_filled",   "GPP_NT_imputed",   list(gpp_predictors),
        "RECO_DT_VUT_REF",  "RECO_DT_filled",  "RECO_DT_imputed",  list(reco_predictors),
        "RECO_NT_VUT_REF",  "RECO_NT_filled",  "RECO_NT_imputed",  list(reco_predictors)
      )
      
      for (ii in seq_len(nrow(gapfill_specs))) {
        response <- gapfill_specs$response[ii]
      
        # if (!response %in% names(a_DD)) next
        if (! is_col_exist(a_DD, response) ) next
      
        result <- fit_rf_gapfill(
          data = a_DD,
          response = response,
          predictors = gapfill_specs$predictors[[ii]][[1]],
          train_condition = !is.na(a_DD[[response]]) & (a_DD$doy %in% doy2train),
          gap_condition = is.na(a_DD[[response]]) & a_DD$year %in% years2fill,
          transform = "none",
          lower_bound = 0,
          seed = 101
        )
        
        # only use high-performance results
        if ( result$diagnostics$OOB_RMSE < 3 & result$diagnostics$OOB_rel_RMSE < 3 & result$diagnostics$n_training > result$diagnostics$n_filled ) {
          a_DD[[gapfill_specs$filled_output[ii]]] <- result$filled
          a_DD[[gapfill_specs$imputed_output[ii]]] <- result$prediction_index          
        }
        #
        perform_rf <- bind_rows(perform_rf, data.frame(site_ID = site, result$diagnostics, n_gapyears = length(years2fill)))
      }

      sum_no_na <- function(x) if (any(is.na(x))) NA_real_ else sum(x)
      a_YY_filled <- a_DD %>%
        group_by(year) %>%
        summarise(across(any_of(c(
          # "NEE_filled", 
          "GPP_DT_filled", "RECO_DT_filled",
          "GPP_NT_filled", "RECO_NT_filled"
        )), sum_no_na), .groups = "drop") %>%
        rename(
          # NEE = any_of("NEE_filled"),
          GPP_DT = any_of("GPP_DT_filled"),
          RECO_DT = any_of("RECO_DT_filled"),
          GPP_NT = any_of("GPP_NT_filled"),
          RECO_NT = any_of("RECO_NT_filled")
        )
      
      if ( all(c("GPP_DT", "RECO_DT", "GPP_NT", "RECO_NT") %in% names(a_YY_filled)) ) {
        a_YY_filled$NEE = (a_YY_filled$RECO_DT - a_YY_filled$GPP_DT + a_YY_filled$RECO_NT - a_YY_filled$GPP_NT) / 2
      } else if (all(c("GPP_DT", "RECO_DT") %in% names(a_YY_filled))) {
        a_YY_filled$NEE = a_YY_filled$RECO_DT - a_YY_filled$GPP_DT
      } else if (all(c("GPP_NT", "RECO_NT") %in% names(a_YY_filled))) {
        a_YY_filled$NEE = a_YY_filled$RECO_NT - a_YY_filled$GPP_NT
      }
      
      # ## make a plot to see gap fill result
      # plot(a_DD$TIMESTAMP, a_DD$NEE_filled)
      # points(a_DD$TIMESTAMP, a_DD$NEE_VUT_REF, col = 'red', main = site)
      #
      if ("NEE" %in% names(a_YY_filled)) { 
        a_YY$NEE_VUT_REF[a_YY$TIMESTAMP %in% years2fill] <- a_YY_filled$NEE[a_YY$TIMESTAMP %in% years2fill]
      }
      if ("GPP_DT" %in% names(a_YY_filled)) {
        a_YY$GPP_DT_VUT_REF[a_YY$TIMESTAMP %in% years2fill] <- a_YY_filled$GPP_DT[a_YY$TIMESTAMP %in% years2fill]
      }
      if ("GPP_NT" %in% names(a_YY_filled)) {
        a_YY$GPP_NT_VUT_REF[a_YY$TIMESTAMP %in% years2fill] <- a_YY_filled$GPP_NT[a_YY$TIMESTAMP %in% years2fill]
      } 
      if ("RECO_DT" %in% names(a_YY_filled)) {
        a_YY$RECO_DT_VUT_REF[a_YY$TIMESTAMP %in% years2fill] <- a_YY_filled$RECO_DT[a_YY$TIMESTAMP %in% years2fill]
      }
      if ("RECO_NT" %in% names(a_YY_filled)) {
        a_YY$RECO_NT_VUT_REF[a_YY$TIMESTAMP %in% years2fill] <- a_YY_filled$RECO_NT[a_YY$TIMESTAMP %in% years2fill]
      }
      #
    }
  }
  
  tmp <- a_YY %>%
    select(TIMESTAMP, NEE_VUT_REF, any_of( c("GPP_DT_VUT_REF", "GPP_NT_VUT_REF", "RECO_DT_VUT_REF", "RECO_NT_VUT_REF"))) %>%
    mutate(site_ID = site, filled = TIMESTAMP %in% years2fill, .before = 1)

  a_YY_Cflux <- bind_rows(a_YY_Cflux, tmp)
}
```

```{r remove some outlier years}
##this chunk generates the years we should remove; 
# it takes about half hour.
#
source(file.path("scripts2026", "00_functions.R"))
df_file_structure <- get_rawflux_file_structure(dir_rawdata)
#
rm_years <- data.frame(site_ID=character(), years=list())
rm_sites <- c()
#
num_na_years <- 0
#
for (i in 1:nrow(sites_long)) {
  # i = 133
  print(i)
  site_ID <- sites_long$site_ID[i]
  print(site_ID)
  folder <- unlist(df_file_structure$folders[df_file_structure$sources == sites_long$source[i]])
  HHfile <- df_file_structure$HHfiles[df_file_structure$sources == sites_long$source[i]]
  YYfile <- df_file_structure$YYfiles[df_file_structure$sources == sites_long$source[i]]
  a_HH <- read.csv(folder[grepl(pattern=paste0(site_ID, HHfile), folder)])
  a_YY <- read.csv(folder[grepl(pattern=paste0(site_ID, YYfile), folder)])
  #
  a_HH[a_HH<=-9999] <- NA
  a_YY[a_YY<=-9999] <- NA
  
  #### use gap-filled a_YY$NEE_VUT_REF
  if (site_ID %in% sites_filled) {
    a_YY <- a_YY %>%
    left_join(a_YY_Cflux %>% filter(site_ID == sites_long$site_ID[i]) %>%
                select(TIMESTAMP, NEE_fill = NEE_VUT_REF), by = "TIMESTAMP") %>%
    mutate(NEE_VUT_REF = coalesce(NEE_VUT_REF, NEE_fill)) %>%
    select(-NEE_fill)
  }
  
  #### The first rule to remove years: the percentage of measured data < 0.2 of the average percentage of measured data; this is a very loose rule. 
  ## for each year, get the percentage of time when data is interpolated.
  a_HH$TIMESTAMP <- ymd_hm(a_HH$TIMESTAMP_START) + (ymd_hm(a_HH$TIMESTAMP_END) - ymd_hm(a_HH$TIMESTAMP_START)) / 2.0
  f.data.measured <- a_HH %>% mutate(YEAR=year(TIMESTAMP)) %>% group_by(YEAR) %>% summarise(f=sum(NEE_VUT_REF_QC==0, na.rm=T) / n())
  # print(f.data.measured)
  #
  tmp <- f.data.measured %>% filter(f > 0.1 & !is.na(f))
  meanf <- mean(tmp$f)
  #
  tmp <- f.data.measured$YEAR[is.na(f.data.measured$f) | f.data.measured$f < min(0.1, meanf/5)]
  # print(tmp)
  #
  #### The second rule to remove years: there are NA values in yearly data.
  tmp <- c(tmp, a_YY$TIMESTAMP[is.na(a_YY$NEE_VUT_REF)])
  num_na_years <- num_na_years + sum(is.na(a_YY$NEE_VUT_REF))
  #
  #### The third rule to remove years with extreme NEE outliers: a year's NEE outside of 3 * sd, and data is less than the average.
  # detect outliers: Using the Interquartile Range (IQR) Method, NOT the sd method
  Q1 <- quantile(a_YY$NEE_VUT_REF, 0.25, na.rm=T)
  Q3 <- quantile(a_YY$NEE_VUT_REF, 0.75, na.rm=T)
  IQR <- max(Q3 - Q1, 100)
  outlier <- !between(a_YY$NEE_VUT_REF, Q1 - 1.5 * IQR, Q3 + 1.5 * IQR)
  tmp <- c(tmp, a_YY$TIMESTAMP[which(outlier & f.data.measured$f < min(0.1, meanf * 0.5))])
  #

  ## data in 2009 at US-KL2, US-KL3, US-KM2, US-KM3, US-KM4 should not be used. 
  ## due to land use change from soybean to natural land cover in 2009.
  if (site_ID %in% c("US-KL2", "US-KL3", "US-KM2", "US-KM3", "US-KM4")) {
    tmp <- c(tmp, 2009)
  }
  # at site IT-Col, low-quality NEE was removed
  if (site_ID == 'IT-Col') {
    tmp <- c(tmp, a_YY$TIMESTAMP[a_YY$NEE_VUT_REF_QC < 0.5])
  }  
  ## at site CH-Dav, data before 2005 should not be used due to NEE discontinuity detected by https://doi.org/10.5194/bg-21-1827-2024
  # CH-Dav has some instrument change and harvest in 2005 and 2006. 
  if (site_ID == 'CH-Dav') {
    tmp <- c(tmp, 1997:2005)
  }
  ## at site CZ-RAJ, data after 2022 should be removed due to human activity
  if (site_ID == 'CZ-RAJ') {
    tmp <- c(tmp, 2022:2024)
  }
  ## at site JP-Spp, disturbance occurred in 2005.
  # reference: Effects of a windthrow disturbance on the carbon balance of a broadleaf deciduous forest in Hokkaido, Japan
  if (site_ID == 'JP-Spp') {
    tmp <- c(tmp, 2000:2005)
  }
  # clearcut in 2022 at SE-Nor
  if (site_ID == "SE-Nor") {
    tmp <- c(tmp, 2022:2025)
  }
  # 
  if (site_ID == "IT-Noe") {
    tmp <- c(tmp, 2015:2021)
  }
  # abnormally NEE in the two years due to severe drought and beetle attack. 
  # up to 2/3 of canopies broken by wet snow and strong wind; strong effect of this disturbance. 
  # (https://www.frontiersin.org/journals/forests-and-global-change/articles/10.3389/ffgc.2023.1197229/full)
  if (site_ID == "CZ-BK1") {
    tmp <- c(tmp, 2019:2025)
  }
  # dramatic change in NEE flux after 2019, and should be removed. 
  if (site_ID == "US-NC2") {
    tmp <- c(tmp, 2020:2025)
  } 
  # AU-DaS: land clear on 1/11/2022; AU-Cpr: We excluded data from Calperum after June 2020 due to an instrument change after which we noted much higher NEP than in previous years
  # reference: https://pmc.ncbi.nlm.nih.gov/articles/PMC12291013/
  if (site_ID == "AU-DaS") {
    tmp <- c(tmp, 2022:2025)
  }  
  if (site_ID == "AU-Cpr") {
    tmp <- c(tmp, 2020:2025)
  }
  # remove two large fires' effect at this site
  if (site_ID == "US-Aud") {
    tmp <- c(tmp, c(2002:2005, 2009))
  }
  # the first 10 years after disturbance is removed
  if (site_ID == "JP-Tmd") {
    tmp <- c(tmp, c(2005:2013))
  }
  # remove abnormal years missing peak growing season. 
  if (site_ID == "CN-Dsh") {
    tmp <- c(tmp, c(2013, 2022, 2024))
  }  
  #
  if (site_ID == "TH-Mae") {
    tmp <- c(tmp, c(2005, 2009))
  }  
  
  #########process the removed years, and put them into data frame
  tmp <- unique(tmp)
  print(tmp)
  #
  if (length(tmp) > 0) {
    rm_years <- rbind(rm_years, data.frame(site_ID=site_ID, years=tmp))
  }
  a_YY_good <- a_YY %>% filter(!TIMESTAMP %in% tmp)
  plot(a_YY_good$TIMESTAMP, a_YY_good$NEE_VUT_REF, main=site_ID)
  #
  # also check partitioned GPP data
  if (sites_long$NEEpartition[i] == 'DT') {
    plot(a_YY_good$TIMESTAMP, a_YY_good$GPP_DT_VUT_REF, main=site_ID)
  } else {
    plot(a_YY_good$TIMESTAMP, a_YY_good$GPP_NT_VUT_REF, main=site_ID)
  }
  # remove the sites without enough data
  if (a_YY_good$TIMESTAMP[nrow(a_YY_good)] - a_YY_good$TIMESTAMP[1] + 1 < data_length_thresh | nrow(a_YY_good) < data_length_thresh) {
    rm_sites <- c(rm_sites, site_ID)
  }
  #
  if (is.na(sites_long$MAT[i])) {
    sites_long$MAT[i] = mean(a_YY_good$TA_F_MDS, na.rm=T)
  }
  if (is.na(sites_long$MAP[i])) {
    sites_long$MAP[i] = mean(a_YY_good$P_ERA, na.rm=T)
  } 
}

## number of years removed due to abnormal NEE: only 20 years, < 1%. 
# nrow(rm_years) - num_na_years - 18
rm_sites <- c(rm_sites, c("AU-Wom", "AU-Lit"))  # most years at the two sites are gap-filled and <10-year measurements.
##
sites_long <- sites_long %>% filter(!site_ID %in% rm_sites)
rm_years <- rm_years %>% filter(site_ID %in% sites_long$site_ID)
write.csv(rm_years, file = file.path('data2026', 'years_to_remove.csv'), row.names = F)

### write out the gap-filled yearly carbon flux
```

```{r calculate ET and PET}
# it takes about half hour.
####
#
# the threshold of P/ETP: > 0.65 wet regions, 0.5-0.65 mediate regions, and < 0.5 dry regions.
# aridity index calculation using PenmanMonteith
library(librarian)
shelf(amerifluxr, Evapotranspiration)
data(constants)
#
# sites_long <- read.csv('data/long_term_ec_sites.csv')
#
# solar radiation should have the unit mega-joule / m2
# 1 W = 1 J/s; daily data is the average of subhourly data
# I need to get Tmin, Tmax, RHmin, RHmax, uz (ERA, the height wind speed is measured at 10m), u2, n or Cd, solar radiation;
#
source(file.path("scripts2026", "00_functions.R"))
df_file_structure <- get_rawflux_file_structure(dir_rawdata)

#
files.Ameri <- list.files(file.path(dir_rawdata, "Ameriflux_BASE"), pattern=".zip$", full.names=T)
#
# water characteristics
water_flux <- data.frame(site_ID=character(), PET=double(), AET=double(), AI=double())
#
for (i in 1:nrow(sites_long)) {
#  i = 9
#  if (i %in% c(15, 16, 35)) {next}  # 16, 35, 
  print(i)
  site_ID <- sites_long$site_ID[i]
  water_flux[i,1] <- site_ID
  # read a_HH and a_YY
  folder <- unlist(df_file_structure$folders[df_file_structure$sources == sites_long$source[i]])
  HHfile <- df_file_structure$HHfiles[df_file_structure$sources == sites_long$source[i]]
  YYfile <- df_file_structure$YYfiles[df_file_structure$sources == sites_long$source[i]]
  a_HH <- read.csv(folder[grepl(pattern=paste0(site_ID, HHfile), folder)])
  a_YY <- read.csv(folder[grepl(pattern=paste0(site_ID, YYfile), folder)])
  # get wind speed, RH, and solar radiation in the Ameriflux base data
  if (sites_long$source[i] == "AmeriFlux_BASE") {
    a_BASE <- amf_read_base(files.Ameri[grepl(site_ID, files.Ameri)], parse_timestamp=TRUE, unzip = T)
    a_BASE[a_BASE<=-9999] <- NA
    if (!site_ID %in% c("US-Los")) {
      RHname <- sort(names(a_BASE)[grepl("RH", names(a_BASE))])[1]
      WSname <- sort(names(a_BASE)[grepl("WS", names(a_BASE))])[1]
      print(WSname)
      a_HH <- a_HH %>% merge(a_BASE[, c("TIMESTAMP_START", RHname, WSname)], by="TIMESTAMP_START", all.x=T) %>% 
        rename("RH" = RHname, "WS_F" = WSname)
    } else {
      # calculate RH from VPD
      a_HH$RH <- pmax(100 - a_HH$VPD_F_MDS / 10 / (0.6108 * exp(17.27 * a_HH$TA_F_MDS / (a_HH$TA_F_MDS + 237.3))) * 100, 10.0)
      a_HH <- a_HH %>% merge(a_BASE[, c("TIMESTAMP_START", "WS_1_1_1")], by="TIMESTAMP_START", all.x=T) %>% 
        rename("WS_F" = "WS_1_1_1")
    }
    # in this data set SW_IN represent PPFD_IN, so convert PPFD_IN to SW_IN to be consistent with FLUXNET
    a_HH$SW_IN_F_MDS <- a_HH$SW_IN_F_MDS / 2.3 
  }
  
  a_HH[a_HH==-9999] <- NA
  a_YY[a_YY==-9999] <- NA
  #
  a_HH$TIMESTAMP <- ymd_hm(a_HH$TIMESTAMP_START) + (ymd_hm(a_HH$TIMESTAMP_END) - ymd_hm(a_HH$TIMESTAMP_START)) / 2.0
  # aggregate these data into average hourly within a pattern year
  climate_hourly <-
    a_HH %>% mutate(
      Month = month(a_HH$TIMESTAMP),
      Day = day(a_HH$TIMESTAMP),
      Hour = hour(a_HH$TIMESTAMP),
      Rs = a_HH$SW_IN_F_MDS * 0.0864,      # convert SW_IN to MJ m-2 day-1
      RH = a_HH$RH,
      uz = a_HH$WS_F
    ) %>%
    group_by(Month, Day, Hour) %>%
    summarise(
      Temp = mean(TA_F_MDS, na.rm = T),
      Rs = mean(Rs, na.rm = T),
      RH = mean(RH, na.rm = T),
      uz = mean(WS_F, na.rm = T)
    ) %>% mutate(Year=2000)
  # interpolate missing RH. 
  if (any(is.na(climate_hourly$RH))) {
    idx <- seq_along(climate_hourly$RH)
    climate_hourly$RH <- approx(idx, climate_hourly$RH, idx)$y
  }
  ####
  # climate_hourly <- data.frame(Year=year(a_HH$TIMESTAMP), Month=month(a_HH$TIMESTAMP), Day=day(a_HH$TIMESTAMP), Hour=hour(a_HH$TIMESTAMP), Minute=minute(a_HH$TIMESTAMP)/60, Temp=a_HH$TA_F_MDS, Rs = a_HH$SW_IN_F_MDS*0.0864, RH=a_HH$RH, uz=a_HH$WS_F)
  # climate_hourly <- climate_hourly %>% group_by(Year, Month, Day, Hour) %>% summarise(Temp=mean(Temp,na.rm=T), Rs=mean(Rs,na.rm=T), RH=mean(RH,na.rm=T), uz=mean(uz,na.rm=T))
#  climate_hourly$Tdew <- climate_hourly$Temp - (100 - climate_hourly$RH) / 5.0
#  
  #### Rs - incoming solar radiation in Megajoules per square metres per day: "Tdew";        
  mydata_PET <- Evapotranspiration::ReadInputs(varnames=c("Temp", "RH", "Rs", "uz"), climate_hourly, constants, stopmissing=c(50,50,50), timestep = "subdaily",
      interp_missing_days = TRUE,
      interp_missing_entries = TRUE,
      interp_abnormal = TRUE,
      missing_method = 'DoY average',
      abnormal_method = 'DoY average',
      message = "yes")
  ####Penman-Monteith FAO56 Reference Crop ET
  if (sites_long$IGBP[i] %in% c("WET", "GRA", "OSH")) {
    try(results_crop <- Evapotranspiration::ET.PenmanMonteith(mydata_PET, constants, ts='daily', solar='data', crop = "short", save.csv="no"))  ###reference crop ET; short=grass, tall=standard crop; 
  } else {
    if (sites_long$MAT[i] > 5) {
      #
      try(results_crop <- Evapotranspiration::ET.PenmanMonteith(mydata_PET, constants, ts='daily', solar='data', crop = "tall", save.csv="no"))  ###reference crop ET; short=grass, tall=standard crop;
    } else {
      #  
      try(results_crop <- Evapotranspiration::ET.PriestleyTaylor(mydata_PET, constants, ts='daily', solar='data', alpha=0.23,
message="yes", AdditionalStats="yes", save.csv="no"))  ###reference crop ET; short=grass, tall=standard crop; 
    }
  }
  # result_PT <- ET.PriestleyTaylor(mydata_PET, constants, ts="daily",
  # solar="data", alpha=0.23, message="yes", AdditionalStats="yes", save.csv="no") 
#### get the actual ET values:
  # conversion of LE = λ ET, λ=(2.501−0.00237∗Tair)^106; LE: W/m2; ET: kg m-2 s-1
  # lambda latent heat of evaporisationin = 2.45 MJ.kg^-1 at 20 degree Celcius,
  lambda <- 2.501 - 0.00237 * mean(a_YY$TA_F_MDS, na.rm=T)
  water_flux$AET[i] <- mean(a_YY$LE_F_MDS / lambda * 0.0864 * 365.25, na.rm=T)
  water_flux$PET[i] <- mean(results_crop$ET.Annual,  na.rm=T)
}
water_flux$AI <- water_flux$AET / water_flux$PET
#####what is the best method for PET calculation in the field? 
write.csv(water_flux, file.path('data2026', 'water_flux_AI.csv'), row.names = F)
#
```

```{r dry, wet, and cold sites classification}
water_flux <- read.csv(file.path('data2026', 'water_flux_AI.csv'))
#
if (!"AI" %in% names(sites_long)) {
  sites_long <- sites_long %>% left_join(water_flux, by='site_ID')

#
sites_long <- sites_long %>% 
  mutate(category=case_when(Climate.class %in% c("Csa", "Csb", "Bsh", "Bsk", "BSh", "BWh", "Bwk", "Aw", "BWk", "BSk") & AI < 0.5 ~ 'dry', 
                            Climate.class %in% c("Csa", "Csb", "Bsh", "Bsk", "BSh", "BWh", "Bwk", "Aw", "BWk", "BSk") & AI >= 0.5 ~ 'wet', 
                            Climate.class %in% c("Am", "Cwa", "Af", "Cwb") ~ "wet", 
                            Climate.class %in% c("Dfa", "Dfb", "Dfc", "Dfd", "Dsb", "ET", "Dwb", "Dwc") ~ "cold", 
                            Climate.class %in% c("Cfa") ~ "wet",
                            Climate.class %in% c("Cfb") & IGBP != 'EBF' ~ "cold",  # those sites has winters and in high latitudes
                            Climate.class %in% c("Cfb") & IGBP == 'EBF' ~ "wet"    # EBF: evergreen broadleaf forests. 
                            ))

sites_long$category[sites_long$site_ID %in% c('US-Me2')] <- 'cold'

sites_long$category[sites_long$site_ID == "US-Vcp"] <- "dry"
# "US-Vcp" was in New Mexico, a semi-arid ENF. 

sum(sites_long$category=='dry', na.rm = T)

sum(sites_long$category=='wet', na.rm = T)
# we have 33 wet sites.
sum(sites_long$category=='cold', na.rm = T)
```
